The GTS Strategy and Insights team helps shape where GTS goes next—and how we tell that story. jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering
jobs.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You Are

You have spent a decade building systems that ship, not prototypes that impress in slide decks. You know the gap between a working demo and a production system that 500 engineers trust with their daily workflow, and you have closed that gap more than once. You think in platforms, not projects. When you see three teams solving similar problems in different ways, you build the shared layer that makes the fourth team move twice as fast.

You are the kind of leader who can sit with a principal engineer debugging an LLM orchestration failure in the morning and walk into an executive review that afternoon to explain why responsible AI governance is not overhead, it is how you earn customer trust at scale. You do not wait for perfect clarity. You work with what you have, make the right tradeoffs, and move the organization forward without creating chaos downstream.

At Synopsys, you will lead the engineering effort that turns agentic AI from high-potential experiments into production systems that change how semiconductor and EDA work actually gets done. The team is global, the problems are hard, and what you build will matter.

What You'll Be Doing

Own and deliver a portfolio of agentic AI programs across product engineering, semiconductor IP, applications, operations, and customer-facing teams, driving each from prototype through pilot to production deployment with clear adoption metrics
Define reference architectures for agentic workflows that combine LLMs, tool use, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and human oversight, setting engineering standards for reliability, testing, and release readiness that go beyond demos
Build reusable platforms and shared components including tool-use frameworks, RAG patterns, evaluation harnesses, prompt governance, model routing, and safety guardrails that reduce duplication and accelerate adoption across business units
Translate between AI technology capabilities, domain engineering realities in EDA and semiconductor workflows, product priorities, and executive goals, influencing senior stakeholders to align on tradeoffs, timelines, and risk posture
Lead, coach, and grow a team of principal engineers, staff engineers, and applied scientists, running design reviews, setting technical direction, and building a culture of ownership, pragmatism, and production discipline
Partner with infrastructure, security, legal, and compliance teams to make agentic systems observable through telemetry and tracing, secure through data controls and threat modeling, and responsible through policy and human-in-the-loop governance
Represent the AI Excellence Group with internal leaders and strategic customers to build credibility, manage risk, and ensure solutions connect to measurable business outcomes like quality improvement, cycle time reduction, and cost savings

The Impact You Will Have

Ship multiple production agentic AI deployments per year that measurably improve engineering velocity, product value, and internal efficiency across Synopsys silicon-to-systems portfolio
Establish the default standards and golden path implementations for agentic AI across the company, reducing time-to-pilot for new use cases and increasing reuse of shared components
Accelerate adoption by publishing templates, playbooks, and repeatable patterns that help teams move from idea to deployed solution without reinventing foundational infrastructure
Build organizational capability in agentic systems engineering that outlasts any single project, creating the people, practices, and platforms needed to sustain AI transformation at Synopsys scale
Reduce risk and earn customer trust by embedding observability, security, and responsible AI governance into every deployment, not as afterthoughts but as core design principles
Drive measurable business outcomes including cycle-time reduction, defect reduction, productivity gains, cost savings, and improved customer satisfaction across EDA, IP, simulation, and solver workflows
Create a high-performing team culture that attracts and retains senior technical talent and sets the bar for engineering excellence in applied AI at Synopsys

What You'll Need

10+ years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of shipping reliable production systems, not research prototypes
3+ years leading senior technical teams at the staff or principal engineer level and delivering cross-organizational programs that required influencing without direct authority
Hands-on experience with modern AI application patterns including LLMs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, orchestration frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production deployment workflows
Strong systems thinking across product experience, data pipelines, infrastructure, security, and operational tradeoffs, with the ability to make pragmatic decisions under ambiguity
Exceptional communication skills with both deeply technical audiences and executive or customer-facing stakeholders, able to explain complex tradeoffs clearly and drive alignment on risk and timelines
Experience in EDA, semiconductor workflows, system-level simulation, physics-based solvers, or complex enterprise engineering tools is a strong plus
Experience building internal platforms or shared services used by multiple teams, such as developer productivity tools, ML/AI platforms, or governance frameworks, is a strong plus

Who You Are

You can walk into a room where three teams are building similar agentic workflows and walk out with a plan for a shared platform that makes the fourth team move twice as fast without forcing anyone to rewrite working code
When a pilot shows promise but the eval scores are inconsistent and the latency spikes under load, you know which problems to solve now and which to instrument and monitor, because you have been here before
You push back when a roadmap is built on optimism instead of engineering reality, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than shutting down the conversation
You can explain to a VP why responsible AI governance is not compliance theater, it is how you avoid the incident that costs customer trust, and you can do it in two sentences without losing the nuance
You hire and develop senior engineers who do not need hand-holding but do need someone who can unblock cross-org dependencies, set technical direction, and protect the team from thrash
You treat production deployments as the beginning of the work, not the end, because adoption, observability, and iteration are what turn a shipped system into a trusted one

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will lead a team of principal engineers, staff engineers, and applied scientists within the AI Excellence Group, focused on delivering trusted, production-grade agentic AI capabilities across Synopsys. The group's mission is to turn high-potential AI opportunities into scalable platforms, repeatable patterns, and deployed solutions that measurably improve product value, engineering velocity, and internal efficiency across the silicon-to-systems portfolio, including EDA, semiconductor IP, system-level simulation, and physics-based solvers. You will partner closely with product engineering, infrastructure, security, legal, and compliance teams, and represent the group with senior leaders and strategic customers.

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Synopsys Canada ULC values the diversity of our workforce. We are committed to provide access & opportunity to individuals with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodation to individuals throughout the recruitment and employment process. Should you require an accommodation, please contact hr-help-canada@synopsys.com.

The Assistant Vice President, Architecture & Engineering Enablement is responsible for defining and enabling the technology foundation that supports the organization's strategic objectives, digital transformation initiatives, and operational excellence goals. This role leads enterprise and solution architecture, engineering enablement, cloud platforms, reliability engineering, technology risk metrics, release enablement, and modernization programs.

As a senior technology leader, the AVP establishes the architectural direction for business and technology platforms while ensuring engineering teams are equipped with the standards, environments, tooling, governance, and platform capabilities necessary to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions. The role serves as a critical link between business strategy, technology delivery teams, infrastructure operations, and executive leadership.

The AVP is accountable for technology roadmap alignment, modernization planning, engineering effectiveness, operational resilience, cloud adoption, and technical risk reduction, while driving consistency and excellence across the software delivery lifecycle.

Position Responsibilities

Architecture Leadership

Lead the Architecture function and define the strategic technology direction and target-state architecture across the portfolio.
Develop and maintain multi-year application and technology roadmaps aligned with business strategy, enterprise standards, security, data, and cloud direction.
Lead solution architecture and provide oversight for strategic transformation, modernization, cloud adoption, and major technology investments.
Establish architecture governance, standards, reference architectures, and solution design review practices.
Drive application rationalization, technical debt reduction, platform simplification, and modernization planning.
Lead technology intake and assessments, evaluating feasibility, complexity, dependencies, architectural impact, and high-level estimates.
Provide technical leadership for business cases, RFPs, vendor evaluations, and technology investment decisions.

Engineering Enablement Leadership

Lead the Engineering Enablement function, providing the platforms, environments, tooling, standards, and practices required for secure, scalable, and efficient software delivery.
Drive engineering excellence through automation, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, and modern cloud engineering practices.
Own cloud and on-premise environment strategy, ensuring availability, stability, scalability, resiliency, security, and cost effectiveness.
Lead release enablement, establishing deployment controls, production readiness standards, and practices that improve delivery velocity while reducing risk.
Lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and operational resilience, including availability, performance, observability, recoverability, SLOs, and continuous improvement.
Lead technology risk governance, IRM metrics, remediation plans, and executive reporting, ensuring alignment with security, audit, regulatory, and operational risk requirements.
Drive legacy and mainframe-to-cloud modernization, reducing technical debt and improving platform efficiency, scalability, and cost effectiveness.

Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness

Lead and develop a high-performing organization of architects, platform engineers, SREs, release enablement professionals, and technology specialists.
Build organizational capabilities across architecture, cloud engineering, reliability, automation, and modern software delivery.

About Bells Of Steel Inc.

At Bells of Steel, our mission is to make fitness and strength training approachable, affordable, and fun. We design and manufacture high-quality strength and exercise equipment for home gym owners and fitness professionals, helping people of all experience levels achieve their goals.

We’re not your typical fitness equipment brand. We’re down-to-earth, a little cheeky, and focused on making fitness more rewarding and less intimidating. If you enjoy a fast-paced, no-BS environment and want to help shape the future of strength training, you’ll fit right in.

Adaptability – Raise the Bar

We challenge the status quo, learn quickly, and continuously improve. We embrace change, seek better ways of working, and take initiative to drive results.

Customer Centricity – Always Spot the Customer

Everything we do is focused on helping our customers succeed. We lead with empathy, build trust through action, and create value for both external and internal customers.

Teamwork – We Win Together

We operate with honesty, transparency, trust, and respect. We collaborate openly, take shared ownership of outcomes, and succeed as a team.

About Bells Of Steel Inc.

We’re a rapidly growing e-commerce company that designs and sells strength equipment across Canada, the USA, the UK, Australia, and now Europe, starting with Germany. We compete with the biggest names in the industry by moving fast, listening to customers, and building products that punch above their weight.

Our purpose is to make strength training accessible to all, and have fun doing it. Our 10-year target is 1 million customers made stronger, and over the next three years we’re growing to $50 million USD in annual revenue.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Director of Marketing

to own how Bells of Steel reaches, wins, and keeps customers in every market we serve.

This is a strategic leadership role responsible for deciding where we show up, what we say, and how every marketing dollar earns its place.

You'll own our marketing strategy, brand positioning, channel and campaign calendar, paid media strategy, creative strategy and testing, and the marketing Scorecard. You'll work closely with our founder, e-commerce, product, sales, customer service, finance, and our international teams to turn great products into growth.

You'll lead a marketing team of about 16 people across marketing operations, retention, affiliates and partnerships, social and community, creative and video, and paid search and paid social. You don't need to do it all yourself, but you need to be strong enough in each area to coach your channel owners and hold them to a high standard.

This is an AI-first role

. Over your first year, you'll lead an AI transformation across marketing: upgrading and replacing manual workflows with AI, and working with our in-house developers to build our own tools that outperform the paid software we use today.

If you're someone who reads a Scorecard like a story, moves budget toward what works and away from what doesn't, and can build a brand that real lifters trust, we'd love to meet you.

This is a hybrid role based in Calgary, with about half your time in the office and half working from home. Your office days are where the best marketing happens: in the photo studio for a shoot, on the showroom floor talking to customers, walking over to the product team to plan a launch, and lifting on the equipment you're selling.

Relocation support is available for the right candidate.

What You'll Be Doing

Marketing Strategy & Brand Positioning

Own the 1–3 year marketing strategy, tied to our company goals of $50M USD revenue by 2029 and 1 million customers made stronger.
Own our brand positioning across every market, built on our three uniques: maximum training value per square foot, function over hype, and real people with real strength.
Grow our reach with former lifters, practical beginners, parents, and professionals without losing the core lifters who built the brand.
Make sure our customer journey, from discovery to setup to training, and our 30-day money back guarantee show up consistently in every customer touchpoint.

Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team (~16 people) using EOS principles.
Create clarity around priorities, accountability, and execution, with KPIs for every seat.
Give every Quarterly Goal a definition of done, milestones and an owner at the start of the quarter.
Bring in outside experts where we are weak, and check their work before it ships.
Build a high-performing team capable of making excellent marketing decisions without constant executive involvement.

AI Transformation

Work AI-first, and set the standard for how the marketing team uses AI to plan, create, analyze, and report.
Lead a 12-month AI transformation across marketing: map every manual workflow, then upgrade it or replace it with AI.
Partner with our in-house developers to build internal tools that work better than our paid SaaS stack, and retire subscriptions once the replacement is proven.
Measure the results in hours saved, output per person, and software spend cut, and report them on the marketing Scorecard.
Coach every member of the team to work AI-first, and develop an AI champion within marketing.

Paid Media Strategy

Own paid media strategy across Google, Meta, Amazon, Reddit, and display.
Set targets for return on ad spend, acquisition cost, and new customer growth, and hold channel owners to them.
Make sure creative, landing pages, and offers work together from the first click to checkout.

Scorecard, Performance & Budget

Own the marketing Scorecard and adjust strategy based on results.
Set clear targets for every channel, benchmark against the industry, and dig into the stories behind the numbers.
Set and allocate the marketing budget and resources for the best return, and cut what isn't working quickly.
Write the rules for when we scale spend and when we stop it, and make a documented budget decision every week.
Work alongside Finance and Leadership on budgeting, forecasting, customer acquisition cost, and profitability.

Creative Strategy & Testing

Own creative strategy and run a standing testing program. Every test has a written hypothesis, a result and a decision, reported weekly on the Scorecard.
Set the weekly ad output target and hit it.
Own landing pages for paid traffic: build new pages for key products and campaigns, A/B test them, and report conversion rate by page.
Turn reviews, support tickets and community threads into new ad angles every month.
Stay ahead of the craft. Follow the podcasts, newsletters, creators and competitor ad libraries where new formats show up, and get the promising ones into test within weeks.

Channel & Campaign Calendar

Set our channel strategy across paid media, email and SMS, affiliates and creators, social, YouTube, community, and showrooms.
Own the annual marketing calendar and our Annual Playbook, keeping revenue teams aligned on a shared campaign cadence planned 12 months ahead.
Lead our major promotions (BFCM and more) and product launches with Product, E-Commerce, and Sales.
Own marketing results in each international market (UK, Australia, Germany, France), with a Scorecard row per market.
Make marketing for each market, not copies of North American ads: local creators, local spelling and units, local homes and seasons, local offers and delivery promises.
Own local marketing for each showroom.

What You Bring

You have your own active strength training routine and lift weights regularly
5+ years of marketing experience at a direct-to-consumer or e-commerce brand.
5+ years of experience managing people/leading a team.
An AI-first way of working. You use AI every day, have used it to replace manual work, and would rather build better tools than buy more software.
Experience building multi-year marketing strategies and brand positioning that drove measurable growth.
Hands-on depth in paid media (Google, Meta, Amazon) and a strong grasp of ROAS, CAC, LTV, and attribution.
You still open the ad account yourself. You can find a problem in Ads Manager without waiting for a report.
You have built and A/B tested landing pages and can show the results.
Experience running email and SMS, affiliate and creator, social, and content programs, and an understanding of how they work together.
Strong analytical skills. You build and read dashboards, understand the stories behind the numbers, and make budget decisions from data.
Strong creative judgment. You know great creative when you see it and can lead a creative team toward it.
Excellent leadership skills. You enjoy coaching teams, making decisions, and creating alignment across departments.
Comfortable making difficult prioritization decisions with imperfect information, following 80/20 and iterating quickly.
Experience marketing in more than one country, with creative made for each market, is strongly preferred.
Willing to travel for trade shows, content shoots, showrooms, and our international markets.

What's In It For You

Competitive salary ($110k-$145k)
Health Spending Account
Hybrid schedule: 3 days/week in a Calgary office you'll actually want to come into, the rest from home
24 paid Fridays off per year

You’ll partner with business and technology leaders to simplify and modernize our global technology landscape, establish scalable standards, and ensure major technology investments translate into sustainable business outcomes. Support global time zones: Work closely with stakeholders across Pacific and APAC regions, with flexibility to adjust working hours on most days as business needs require.

Lead global enterprise architecture: Define current-state, target-state, and transition architectures, roadmaps, principles, and standards across ERP, Finance, HCM, Procurement, CRM/MarTech, Legal, Risk & Compliance, ECM, and other corporate platforms.
Drive modernization and simplification: Lead application portfolio rationalization and recommend where platforms should be standardized, modernized, consolidated, replaced, or retired to reduce technical debt and complexity.
Shape strategic technology investments: Provide architecture leadership for major transformation initiatives, evaluating SaaS and enterprise platforms against business value, integration, data, security, scalability, total cost, and long-term strategic fit.
Advance AI, data, and integration strategy: Establish scalable patterns for enterprise data, APIs, integration, automation, AI, identity, and shared services while embedding security, privacy, governance, and regulatory requirements.
Collaborate across the global enterprise: Partner with senior business leaders, Product, Data & AI, Cloud & DevOps, Cybersecurity, Integration, Legal, Procurement, Risk, and strategic vendors to turn architecture strategy into executable outcomes.

What You Bring

Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline preferred.
12+ years of relevant experience: Significant experience in enterprise architecture, domain architecture, technology strategy, or large-scale transformation within complex global or federated organizations.
Enterprise platform architecture expertise: Demonstrated experience architecting and modernizing complex technology portfolios, including experience across at least two of the following three domains: Finance/ERP, HR/HCM, and CRM/MarTech.
Strong technical and transformation expertise: Deep understanding of SaaS platforms, application rationalization, enterprise integration, APIs, data architecture, cloud, cybersecurity, identity, AI/automation, and executable transition roadmaps.
Executive influence and communication: Proven ability to advise senior executives, challenge vendor and solution assumptions, and translate complex architectural decisions into clear business outcomes while remaining technically credible with architecture and engineering teams.
